comparisons.evidence: P's core concept focuses primarily on calendar slots ("Pre-loaded calendar embedding"), while Q uncovers more high-frequency, impactful daily bottlenecks with interventions like "Compulsion Tollbooth," which redirects the "first daily launch of a user-selected compulsive app" to capture user attention within highly active daily habits.

P maps explicit step-by-step causal linkages ("causes decision cost... to drop to ~zero → increases conversion"), and Q balances this rigor perfectly with clear, linear strings ("Calendar transition → contextual micro-session → repeated immediate recovery → DAU") mapping out every survivor's path.

P explicitly screens ideas based on their ability to "survive contact" with real user behaviors and technical constraints. Conversely, Q elevates highly fragile mechanics like "Compulsion Tollbooth," admitting that "operating-system restrictions, irritation, and easy bypass threaten survival in real use" without presenting a clear way to circumvent those ecosystem limits.

Both outputs are exceptional at framing precise testing strategies. P designs a cheap test tracking the "repeat-send-rate within two weeks" rather than a one-time gimmick, while Q outlines building a specific "browser extension for Gmail or Slack with a user-invoked 'pause before send' button" to isolate metrics before writing automation.

P's ultimate recommendations settle on familiar themes of calendars and social features. Q delivers highly novel behavioral reframings, such as "Pleasure Primer," which uniquely positions meditation as "sensory amplification rather than stress treatment" to prime pleasurable activities.

P's conceptual space narrows into 6 merged variations. Q explores a much wider surface area of the solution space across 14 candidates, leveraging distinct causal mechanisms ranging from digital workflow speed anomalies ("tab thrashing") to alternative morning routine interactions ("Alarm Interlock").

P implements an aggressive, structured "Pairwise knockout" stage that actively removes clutter to leave the reader with exactly two highly distinct recommendations. Q dilutes its curation by ultimately delivering a spread of four separate recommended implementations.
